disposition: publish only after transition review and merge; no scientific stage is re-run

failure.root_cause: _terminal_documents() granted Outcome B from self-asserted JSON fields. A red-team pass forged a passing terminal state in scratch in under a second by patching resolved_blocking_defects on the ledger and writing six boolean documents plus eleven readiness stubs, and faked the twelve-hour continuity lane in 0.02s by writing three segment receipts with self-declared durations.
secondary: candidate_frozen, principal_complete, replication_complete and hidden_composition_complete were bool(document): any non-empty JSON satisfied them.
io.contains_true_activation matched only the exact lowercase key 'activation'; Activation, ACTIVATION and external_activation with truthy values were not detected.
thresholds_preserved and challenges_preserved were hardcoded True literals in freeze(), never computed against the live SESOI, power target or configuration digest.
failure.specification_reference: the governing specification requires deliberately constructed counterfeits to be rejected by the verifier; several were not

repair.activation_scan: keys whose casefolded form is activation or external_activation must be exactly False; recursion through dicts, lists and tuples retained; JSON embedded in strings is still not parsed
repair.behavior: re-execute the cheap verifiers at seal time, replace existence checks with content checks, widen activation scanning, compute the preservation claims, and disclose the verification method of every gate
repair.history_intact_tightening: the live recomputation is authoritative over a forged document, but the sealed immutability receipt must still be present and affirmative, so the live check cannot become a way to pass without one
repair.not_re_executed_and_why: reproduce_null(), the discrimination beds and the continuity lane are not re-run at seal. They are the sealed scientific result rather than claims about it, they cost hours, and re-running them would change what sealed means.
repair.preservation_claims: thresholds_preserved compares live SESOI, power target and configuration digest against the freeze; challenges_preserved compares the challenge authority and generator commitments on disk against it. Either emits null with a reason rather than True when it cannot be computed; the existing freeze lacks power_target, so thresholds_preserved is null rather than a soft True.
repair.seal_time_re_execution: mutation_report() and counterfeit_report() run live at seal (0.76s total for the whole terminal document build); a gate passes only when the live result passes and agrees with the stored document, and any disagreement is recorded under seal_check_disagreements. historical drift is recomputed against the preflight tag.
